display_name: Two printed figures that section 361 of the Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law, 5778-2018, wrote into the Execution Law, 5727-1967, recorded as typed values with their tests: the two paragraphs of s 7א2 that both cover a total debt of exactly 150,000, and the fixed 26,000 of s 76(ג) beside the 25,630 and 39,945 of the Insolvency Law's own s 234(א)(1)(א) as enacted (two defects), with one control for each; not an encoding of either Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the individual to whom the Law is applied: the individual debtor whose total debt is compared with the figure in s 7א2, and the employee whose claim for unpaid wages is limited by the figure in s 76(ג). The row asks no question from the seat because it records references.

source.deposit_is: an EXCERPT of the Hebrew Wikisource page of the Execution Law; its first lines give the revision, the whole page's sha256 and size, and the page line numbers copied
source.note: the excerpt is an unofficial consolidation; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are printed pages 366 and 407 of Sefer HaChukim 2708, in amending-laws/ with their page images. The Wikisource consolidation of the Insolvency Law was not deposited. The deposited PDF is a three-page extract of the issue as downloaded; its page 1 is printed page 310 (read from its running header only), its pages 2 and 3 are printed pages 366 and 407.
source.official_pdf_is: a three-page extract of Sefer HaChukim 2708 (printed pages 310, 366 and 407); only the pages read are deposited

expected_red.note: two assertions for each of two defects, each stating what the printed words need. Defect 1: paragraphs (1) and (2) of Execution Law s 7א2, as inserted by s 361 of the Insolvency Law (Sefer HaChukim 2708 p. 407), both cover a total debt of exactly 150,000 shekels. Defect 2: the figure written into Execution Law s 76(ג) by the same section (p. 407) is 26,000, and s 234(א)(1)(א) of the Insolvency Law as enacted fixes 25,630 for wages and 39,945 for severance pay together with wages (p. 366); the Law does not say that the figures must be the same, and the assertions state the reading under which one figure serves both (fork F2 in NOTES.md)

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images of the two official pages were read by the builder
